title: Private Market & Food Tour
text: I had signed up for the group tour but not enough people signed up so I was given the option of a refund, tapas tour or private tour for an additional fee. We opted for the private tour and it was great! Our guide, Emma, was kind and very knowledgeable about the history of Granada. We learned so much more about Granada than just where the great food spots were. Would 100% recommend the tour, but if you can afford, opt for the private.
author: monicahN1674DQ

title: Fabulous food experience
text: The food tour through Granada was fantastic. Emma is so knowledgeable about food and Granada it made the experience and her perfect pace of the trip exceptional. If you want to experience food then Emma is the guide you want!
author: gabriellewQ3435WZ

title: Enjoyable time!
text: Enjoyable relaxed conversation and experience. We did lots of tastings at different places and found out a lot we wouldn't have known about otherwise. And we didn't need lunch afterwards!
author: John_C

title: To do
text: Extremely friendly and diverse food tour. I recommend!

title: Excellent day time food activity!
text: Excellent day time food tour. Our tour guide Adrian was very knowledgeable, informative and engaging. This tour is a wonderful way to familiarize yourself of excellent places to purchase and consume fresh fruits, vegetables, dried fruits, nuts, olive oil, cheese, cured and cooked pork in Granada. During my extended stay in Granada, I’ve returned and frequented a number of the places visited  with this tour. title: The Granada Market tour rocks!
text: This was a great food tour, starting with breakfast and ending with tapas and drinks.  Our guide spoke fluent English and was so engaging.  She knew everything about Grenada.  This was a great experience.

title: Granada Food and Tapas Tour

title: Wonderful!
text: Delicious food and lovely company. Our tour guide, Emma, was so warm, welcoming, and knowledgable. Excellent for the whole family.

title: Great food tour of Granada
text: We had a fantastic tour with Emma. She was knowledgeable, friendly and had a great knowledge of the city. It was a great way to spend the morning with Granada and see a whole new part of the city. The food was great, as well!
